notes: The authored fleet mapping for NX Wisp (SPEC F45). Copy this file to
override it wholesale — the override replaces these rules, it does not
A rule is {id, app?, field, when, urgency, text, expression?, cooldown_ms?,
defer_ms?, stale_after_ms?}. Omit `app` (or use "*") to match every app on
the bus; `field` accepts "*" too. `when.op` is one of: changed, nonempty,
is_true, is_false, eq, one_of, above, below, crosses_above, crosses_below,
urgency is whim | notable | answer | alarm, and alarm is expensive: it is
free of the attention budget and it breaks flow, so it is reserved for the
one thing that genuinely cannot wait.
FIELD NAMES: pulsenx {hr, connected} is live today and declared in NX Hub's
registry overlay. nx-sentry {armed, tripped, region} and wivrn-nx {session,
clients} are PROPOSED — neither app joins the bus yet. nx-hub {updates} is
synthesised locally by wisp-fleet from `nx list --json`, because the hub is
the bus's server and never one of its clients.
The `present` field is synthetic: wisp-fleet emits it when an app appears on
